mediaComposer.purpose: Bounded native Media Composer MXF count/rate import audit, distinguishing physical descriptor timing, audio sampling and editing/timecode clocks.
mediaComposer.method: Read-only fresh selective arm64 disassembly, existing scanner/descriptor path proof, typed toolkit getter/vtable resolution and comparison with prior native rate audit. No app/private API, parser, media writes or repository edits.

findings.evidence: Prior native Kind proof connects ordinary LocalMDB/MSMDB MXF scan to AAFDomain::CopyOut, AComposition::ConvertCompositionFromAAF and the source mob's own EssenceDescriptor/CreateDescriptor. The created descriptor receives ConvertDescriptorFromAAF. Fresh clock slots resolve PCMA, DID and CDCI import/property methods; PCM GetAAFProperties calls AudioMediaDesc::GetAAFProperties at 0x3ea24c and the latter calls AFileMediaDesc::GetAAFProperties at 0x362b28. DID GetAAFProperties calls the same base at 0x381e30. Thus the count/rate getters are in the actual typed MXF physical import route.

findings.topic: File descriptor count and rate are a pair
findings.evidence: The method queries IAAFFileDescriptor on the supplied own descriptor, obtains its Length and rational SampleRate, and sets the internal descriptor length and rate. The ordinary video DID/CDCI setters resolve to the base file-descriptor state. It does not substitute master/clip Length here. The toolkit's named GetLength/GetSampleRate targets are independently resolved; their corresponding MXF fields are ContainerDuration/SampleRate, rather than a text duration or wall-clock timestamp.
findings.widthLimit: The toolkit GetLength interface takes a signed 64-bit output, but this selected engine caller loads w1 from the temporary result and calls SetLength(int). Native internal count truncation/32-bit storage is not a Bella requirement and does not replace Bella's approved checked 64-bit count retention.

findings.topic: Missing descriptor pair is detected, but native subclasses propagate failure differently
findings.evidence: The base property importer checks the HRESULT before consuming each temporary output. A failed GetLength emits "Missing length on fileDescriptor.", marks its result false, and continues to try SampleRate. Failed GetSampleRate emits "Missing sampleRate on fileDescriptor." and also marks its result false. The Length temporary is not explicitly initialized to zero in this function; zero is not proved to mean absent. DID tests the base result and exits on false. Audio calls the base importer without checking its boolean before importing sound properties. PCM separately logs a zero length but continues. Therefore these blocks do not establish universal native rejection, blank display or recovery for all missing/damaged descriptors.
findings.fallbackLimit: No own file-track fallback is present in the base count/rate block, and the separately inspected source/component span routes do not prove exact physical container coverage. Bella leaving an unusable own count/rate pair unavailable, without source/master duration recovery, is a proposed first-release design boundary rather than a claimed universal Media Composer fallback rule.

findings.topic: Native rational import has explicit aliases
findings.evidence: Denominator 1 produces a native integer ExactEditRate. Exact 30000/1001 or 2997/100 uses Avid's 29.97 form; 24000/1001 uses its 23.976 form. Additional finite exact cases include 48000/1001, 60000/1001, 120000/1001 and 240000/1001. Other inputs divide numerator by denominator as double and call ExactEditRateFromFloat. This is a native internal representation boundary, not a reason to decimalise a precise MXF rational in Bella. Prior physical metadata/export paths convert supported native video conventions back to rational essence rate.

findings.topic: Audio sampling rate is a distinct property
findings.evidence: After the base file descriptor import, audio imports the SoundDescriptor's separate rational AudioSamplingRate and stores it as the audio frequency. The internal getter returns state at this+0x450. The existence of this property does not show that every recorded ContainerDuration uses audio-sample units; the physical count's own descriptor SampleRate supplies its unit clock. Matching 48000 rates in ordinary OP-Atom examples can make the clocks numerically equal without making them universally interchangeable.

findings.topic: PCM public rate getters have extra coupling
findings.evidence: PCM SetRate first sets the base descriptor rate, then initializes audio sampling rate through its virtual setter. Later AudioSamplingRate import can replace that audio frequency. PCM GetExactEditRate forwards to GetAudioSamplingRate, while AudioMediaDesc's conditional rate conversion explicitly calls AFileMediaDesc::GetExactEditRate to obtain the separate original descriptor clock. Function names alone therefore do not establish one universal timing clock. Bella need not copy this object/getter architecture.

findings.topic: Conditional audio unit conversion is not a universal rule
findings.evidence: A specific essence-container prefix gate precedes this branch. Only inside it, when descriptor rate and audio sampling rate differ, native code converts the current Length from TrueNTSCEditRate(descriptorRate) to AudioSamplingRate and replaces internal Length. ConvertEUs computes count * destinationRate / sourceRate in double and rounds to an integer with a signed half adjustment. The compared wire-label prefix is 060e2b34010401010d0103010201; the last two bytes are not part of that compared prefix. This does not authorise all audio-MXF count conversion or Bella's blind use of AudioSamplingRate as ContainerDuration's divisor.

findings.topic: Track/source spans are separately imported editing facts
findings.evidence: The composition rate fallback helper finds an audio track using DataDefinition, obtains its slot EditRate, and can accumulate segment/component lengths. These are component counts in their editing clock, a separate route from the own file descriptor Length/SampleRate. The selected import code does not establish that this clip span must replace physical ContainerDuration whenever the two differ.

findings.topic: Optional source-sample length does not replace the physical pair by default
findings.evidence: A separate composition branch, gated by a file descriptor and IsTimecodeRateOverrideEnabled, finds the corresponding SourceClip/slot and converts its count from slot EditRate into the audio sampling clock when different. It then sets a separate signed 64-bit SourceLength and _AMD_SOURCE_LENGTH attribute. GetSourceLength returns that separate value if available and otherwise falls back to the internal file Length. This optional editing/import machinery does not establish a general physical-duration source for Bella or justify storing master/source spans merely for Duration.

findings.topic: Recorded timecode supplies numbering, not physical length
findings.evidence: The typed timecode importer reads an AAF timecode structure containing start, drop and nominal FPS, then constructs an internal timecode descriptor. Native optional import overrides can alter numbering/rates. This is separate from physical file Length and does not prove Bella should add StartTimecode, apply the first encountered drop flag or copy current-project override settings. The precise physical Duration UI ownership/default/error path is not fully traced.

mediaComposer.settledBellaBoundary: Preserve approved exact integer/fraction maths, audio precision, HH:MM:SS:FF and qualified numbering. MDB stays first; MXF Duration is permitted on the already agreed database-unavailable MXF fallback. A header rate alone does not repair MDB timing. This audit neither changes those requirements nor approves new detailed MXF field selection, scope or runtime implementation.

findings: Reads qualified own descriptor ContainerDuration and same-descriptor SampleRate; signed 64-bit count and exact positive rational. AudioSamplingRate is separate. Video currently uses descriptor rate for display; audio uses recorded same-header Preface.ProjectEditRate.

Only a genuinely absent ContainerDuration permits its own identified file-track sequence Duration/EditRate fallback. Present-but-damaged count is not repaired. Observed track spans differ from physical descriptor counts in two samples, so they are not universally interchangeable.

Exact limb-based integer/fraction maths and final half-up audio frame rounding are useful verified rules/test cases for new helpers. Current positive-only known/display checks suppress known zero and positive audio rounded to zero. Current DF semicolons match Bella’s separator clarification approved22October; the separator itself needs no correction.

Current DF ownership searches file and linked-master timecode; all thirteen observed file/master graphs lack timecode, while immediate linked sources carry it. Three fractional-clock cases have explicitly qualified zero-start/origin source spans; one records true DF.

Boolean decoding delegates to UInt8, implicitly constructing numeric QVariant(int) in Qt 6.5.3, while projectDropFrame requires exact Bool. No coercion between decoder and projector was found. Compile-only LLVM output independently corroborates the constructor. Existing projection tests inject bool and bypass byte decoding.

Later missing/conflicting Boolean-toBool conversion can default to false. This does not implement Bella genuine-absence NDF versus damaged relevant numbering blank. Current global header-first Duration/DF priority is not Bella approval.

proposal.physicalPair: The already qualified essence-linked physical file descriptor ContainerDuration + its own SampleRate. Preserve nonnegative signed64 count and exact rational with numerator>0 and denominator>0. No master/source segment count or mixed-source repair.
proposal.missingDamagedPair: Leave MXF Duration unavailable and keep physical row/independent facts. No new file-track recovery proposed in release one; retain existing fallback as research until physical-container equivalence is established.
proposal.unitSemantics: Preserve the recorded count unit. General MXF can use frames, fields or coding blocks. Preserve exact PCM samples where the supported representation counts them, otherwise exact native units; do not universally substitute AudioSamplingRate or halve interlaced rates.
proposal.videoDisplayClock: Use the supported own frame/editing clock with known sample-unit interpretation. All eight sampled own video Track.EditRate values equal the descriptor rate. Unobserved variants require verification.
proposal.audioDisplayClock: Use usable recorded Preface.ProjectEditRate from the same active physical header. The five sampled rates match interpreted MDB own-file editing clocks. Do not use 48kHz as FPS, guess current application/project or borrow another master. Missing/damaged required display timing leaves formatted Duration blank.
proposal.numbering: Apply existing qualified recorded DF/NDF-on-proven-absence/blank-on-damaged-relevant-numbering policy to correctly decoded one-byte0/1 Boolean plus RoundedTimecodeBase, track EditRate and range. Follow relevant explicit file-source references with full-ID/track/offset/range validation. No unrelated first flag or StartTimecode addition. Known NDF-only clocks need no DF lookup.
proposal.rangeEvidenceBoundary: Three actual fractional-clock cases have explicit full SourcePackageID/SourceTrackID, zero starts/origins and same-rate timecode covering physical duration. Other nonzero cross-rate audio source positions are not fully generalized; their supported24/25 NDF-only display clocks need no DF lookup.
proposal.interpretationAndMath: Use explicit MXF rationals directly; legacy MDB alias interpreter remains source-specific. Share the agreed exact integer/fraction formatter after interpretation, retain precise audio/native count, round only final audio display frames nearest with half-up. No float/decimal rate-string detour.
proposal.display: Approved format clarification: NDF HH:MM:SS:FF; DF HH;MM;SS;FF. Known zero and positive audio legitimately rounded to zero use the selected mode separators; unavailable required timing stays blank; hours exceed24 without wrap. Audio visible Frame Rate remains blank. Other new detailed MXF field/clock/recovery proposals remain unapproved.
proposal.retention: Only selected count/rate, required display clock, qualified mode and compact availability. Share needed AudioSamplingRate/wrapping facts with other fields; release raw/header/reference/candidate structures. New small C++17/Qt6.5 helpers, no runtime implementation selected here.
proposal.sourceBoundary: Keep usable MDB Duration first. MXF Duration only on already agreed database-unavailable fallback; no Duration-only header open or count/rate/clock/DF hybrid. Full source-priority table and extra-read triggers stay deferred.
